findings: Initial PR5 workflow omitted direct AINative/Maliang/editor inputs
Initial CI exposed missing macOS os.waitid, Ubuntu Pillow and a synchronous Maliang completion busy rejection
R2 macOS CI exposed Darwin listener inspection depending on unusable external lsof results
The first libproc revision mixed IPv4 and IPv6 wildcards; review required same-family targets before wildcard acceptance
observed: Independent read-only review approved the final R3 delta. Existing R2 waitid, Pillow and deferred Maliang fixes remain approved. Darwin now uses libproc process/socket FD records with the system-header-verified 792-byte socket_fdinfo layout, exact TCP LISTEN port/address checks and unique-PID returns. Buffer truncation and API errors fail safely. Address-family review was initially rejected, then fixed by requiring a same-family target before accepting that family's wildcard; IPv4/IPv6 cross-family negative tests and IPv6 positive ownership pass. Windows/Linux listener paths are unchanged.
scope: PR5 R3 complete regression fixes: Darwin waitid, pinned Pillow, deferred Maliang completion follow-up and native Darwin listener ownership
validation_boundary: Approval covers the reviewed source and real targeted Darwin socket/lifecycle tests. The complete AINative suite, exact R3 three-platform CI, Windows first-use Maliang, macOS AIChat/Tianshu and final main readback remain separate required evidence.
